The phrasing is awkward. It implies the line itself has the shape of a marker. A clearer description would be that the line has circular markers at each data point ("с кръгли маркери").
The chart shows a dip in 2006 to a value of approximately 110. The first peak occurs in 2008 with a value of approximately 255.
The value in 2011 is clearly below the 100 gridline, at approximately 80.

errors.text_span: бързо се повишава до 200 в точката 2019
errors.evidence: The value in 2019 is approximately 160, not 200. The data point is significantly below the 200 gridline.
The value of 580 corresponds to the year 2021. The value for 2020 is much lower, at approximately 410.

errors.text_span: за да се стабилизира на 580 до 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The line does not stabilize. It shows a very sharp increase from approximately 410 in 2020 to 580 in 2021. Describing this trend as 'stabilizing' is incorrect and misleading.
